items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Levine was the head of the Grumwald School, Ape and Reed, man. He's from downtown.

ctx.x: He stays uptown. Oh yeah. I haven't seen him for years. And I studied a while under, I can't think of this. I got quite a few ideas from him too. He's one of the boys from downtown, not Levine, Levine was the head of the Grumwald School, Ape and Reed, man. He's from downtown. Where does he live? He played trumpet. He used to, Lejeune I think his name was. I think his name was Lejeune. He used to be a trumpet man. He used to play that dog. Oh, Dejeune. Maybe Harold Dejeune. Leo? Leo Dejeune? Could that be him?…

That must be him. Yeah, one of the, one of the, we're talking man. Does he have a brother play sax now? Play zelto? Real bright font. Real bright font. Yeah. Has a red runnin mouthpiece on a zelto? Yeah, I think so.
